summary: ExoZymes Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) for an underwritten public offering of units consisting of shares of common stock and warrants. The filing states the units are priced at a to-be-determined amount, with warrants exercisable at 125% of the offering price and redeemable under certain conditions. No definitive terms, premium, or expected close are provided. The offering is a standard equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. The filing discloses a conflict of interest with underwriter MDB Capital due to common ownership, with Lucid Capital Markets acting as qualified independent underwriter.
